changelog:
- Initial release of the Vasari Biographical Voice skill.
- Captures the distinctive narrative style of Giorgio Vasari’s Lives, focusing on anecdote, character, and artistic genius.
- Includes detailed style tokens and anti-tokens for shaping output in Vasari’s voice.
- Provides signature passages as reference, plus clear writing and UI/branding guidelines.
- Live demo available for real-time testing and feedback.
summary: Provides biographical voice styled on Vasari, telling artist stories with anecdote-driven character insights and divine genius as creative source.
